items.headline: Flood Watch issued July 31 at 1:22PM AKDT until August 7 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...The following areas, Central Susitna Valley, Lower
Matanuska Valley, Southern Susitna Valley and Western Susitna
Valley.  This includes the cities of Palmer, Wasilla, Big Lake,
Skwentna, Willow, Talkeetna, Trapper Creek, And Petersville.

* WHEN...From Tuesday morning through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDIT

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued July 31 at 1:04PM AKDT until August 5 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 30 to 50 mph with gusts up to 70 mph possible.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From Sunday evening through late Tuesday night.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult, especially for high profile
vehicles. Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates.
